# Beam

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Beam")`

A band of colour or a texture between two attachments: a laser, a tractor beam, a rope of light, lightning with a texture that runs. Straight, or a curve that leaves each attachment along its X. **A picture, not the world** -- it collides with nothing and is drawn on the frame, where its attachments are drawn.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attachment0` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | Where it starts. |
| `Attachment1` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | Where it ends. |
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | Its colour along its length, from `Attachment0` at 0 to `Attachment1` at 1. Multiplies the texture. |
| `CurveSize0` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far the beam leaves `Attachment0` along that attachment's own X before it bends towards the other end, in metres. Zero at both ends is a straight line; negative leaves the other way. |
| `CurveSize1` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far before `Attachment1` the beam is already running along that attachment's own X, in metres. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether it is drawn. |
| `FaceCamera` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the band turns about its own length to face the camera. Off, it lies in the plane of its attachments' Y axes -- a flat ribbon with two sides. |
| `LightEmission` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much it adds its colour to what is behind it instead of covering it: 0 an ordinary surface, 1 light. |
| `LightInfluence` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the scene's light colours it: 1 is lit like a surface, 0 is its own colour at any hour. |
| `Segments` | `number` | `10` | read/write | How many straight pieces a curved beam is drawn as, 1 to 64. A straight beam needs one. |
| `Texture` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image along it, its U along the beam and its V across. None is a plain band of `Color`. |
| `TextureLength` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How long one repeat of the texture is, in metres, in `Wrap` and `Static` modes. |
| `TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch` | read/write | How the texture is laid along it. |
| `TextureSpeed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How fast the texture runs from `Attachment0` towards `Attachment1`: in repeats a second in `Stretch` mode, in metres a second in `Wrap`. `Static` does not run. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | How see-through it is along its length: 0 solid, 1 gone. |
| `Width0` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How wide it is at `Attachment0`, in metres. |
| `Width1` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How wide it is at `Attachment1`, in metres. |
| `ZOffset` | `number` | `0` | read/write | Metres towards the camera it is drawn at, so a beam lying on a wall is not cut by it. |
